policy: Maintainability thresholds are guardrails, not rewrite quotas. Recursive/package-aware source health must fail closed on new production orphan helpers. Pre-existing declaration-only debt is tracked exactly until removed or moved to the correct owner; interface-only methods require explicit contract metadata.
